Module com.mathcat.mathcat
Package com.mathcat.mathcat.dao

Class ItemDAO

java.lang.Object
com.mathcat.mathcat.dao.ItemDAO
public final class ItemDAO extends Object
Provides access to the static item catalog. Items are predefined and shared across all users; the catalog is populated once on class load.

    • addItem

      public static void addItem(int catId, String itemId)
      Adds one of the specified item to a cat's inventory. If the cat already has the item, the quantity is incremented by 1 instead of inserting a new row.
      Parameters:
      catId - the database ID of the cat
      itemId - the catalog ID of the item (e.g. "FOOD_TUNA")

    • useItem

      public static boolean useItem(int catId, String itemId)
      Decrements the quantity of an item in a cat's inventory by 1. If the quantity reaches 0, the row is deleted. Uses a transaction so the inventory never contains a row with 0 quantity.
      Parameters:
      catId - the database ID of the cat
      itemId - the catalog ID of the item to use
      Returns:
      true if the item was used successfully, false if the cat has none

    • loadInventory

      public static ArrayList<Item> loadInventory(int catId)
      Loads all items in a cat's inventory from the database. Each row is matched against the item catalog to get full item details, then added to the list with its saved quantity.
      Parameters:
      catId - the database ID of the cat
      Returns:
      a list of items the cat currently owns, or an empty list if none
